# Municipal Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2000

**Additional Appropriations Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance approves and allocates an additional appropriation of Php 1,986,710.33 to cover the 10% additional salaries of employees/officials and to address the funding shortage in the 2000 Annual Budget. The ordinance allocates funds from the Additional IRA for 2000 and surplus funds from December 31, 1999.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Allocates additional IRA for [[2000]] amounting to Php 1,400,462.00 and surplus as of December 31, [[1999]] amounting to Php 586,248.33, totaling Php 1,986,710.33, for the 10% additional salaries of employees/officials and to address the funding shortage in the [[2000]] Annual Budget.
2.  **Section 2.** The Additional Appropriations No. 02, Series of [[2000]], prepared by the Honorable Mayor, is included and made an additional part of this ordinance marked as "Annex A".
3.  **Section 3.** The Municipal Ordinance on Additional Appropriations No. 02, Series of [[2000]], shall take effect upon its approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Approved on June 5, [[2000]] in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
